pos.notSentYet: Not sent to the kitchen yet

pos.otherBody: It was set up for {org} ({branch}), but this browser is signed in as {email}. Set it up again for your restaurant, or sign in with that restaurant’s account.

pos.shiftExplain: A shift is your working time on this till. Open it before you take the first order, and close it at the end of the day to count the cash.
pos.floatHint: The cash already in the drawer now, for giving change. Count it and type the amount in ৳.

menu.photoHint: Shown on the till when a cashier picks "Photos". Any phone picture works; it is made small automatically.
menu.photoFailed: The photo could not be saved. Check the internet and try again.
menu.title: Menu
menu.subtitle: The menu your cashiers sell from. Prices are the ones on your printed menu.
menu.noItems: No dishes yet. Type a name and a price above and press Add item.
menu.addOnGroupsBody: Things a customer can add or choose with a dish, like Extras or Spice level. Step 1: make a group (for example Extras). Step 2: add choices inside it (for example Extra egg, ৳20). Step 3: open a dish above and tick the group.
menu.noGroupsYet: Nothing here yet. Start with a group, like "Extras", then add choices inside it.
menu.howIntro: Do the steps in order. The first two are all you need to start selling.
menu.step1Body: Groups keep the menu tidy, like Rice & Curry or Drinks.
menu.step2Body: Type each dish name and the price on your printed menu.
menu.step3Body: Tap a dish to add a photo, sizes like Half and Full, or extras like an extra egg.
menu.categoriesBody: Groups that keep the menu tidy, like Rice & Curry or Drinks. Make these first, then add dishes into them.
menu.itemsBody: Your dishes and drinks. Tap a dish to add a photo, sizes or extras. To take a dish off the till without losing it, press Hide.
menu.itemExtras: {count, plural, one {# extras group} other {# extras groups}}
menu.variantsBody: Use this when one dish comes in different sizes or types at different prices, like Half and Full. Leave it empty if the dish has one price.
menu.priceDeltaHint: Compared with the dish price: -50 means ৳50 cheaper, 50 means ৳50 more, empty means the same.
menu.itemExtrasBody: Tick the extras that go with this dish, then press Save. You make extras in the box at the bottom of this page.
menu.itemNoGroups: No extras made yet. Make one in the "Extras and choices" box at the bottom of this page.
menu.groupRangeHint: At least 0 means optional. At least 1 means the cashier must choose one, like a spice level.

type.service_slow_slot: Slow service at a busy time

impactLabel.usage_unexplained: Worth, beyond what other branches lose

evidence.staffVsPeers: {count} in {orders} orders ({value}); colleagues' rate would predict {expected}.
evidence.peers: Colleagues at this branch: {count} in {orders} orders ({value}).
evidence.cashShare: {share} of their {orders} orders were cash; {expected} expected for the same times of day.
evidence.commission: {orders} orders, {net} in sales; commission {pct} = {commission}. All platform costs: {share} of its sales.
evidence.marginBelowTarget: {qty} sold for {net}; recipe cost {cost}: food cost {pct} against a {target} target.
evidence.negativeMargin: {qty} sold for {net}; recipe cost {cost} plus commission {commission} is more than the sales.
evidence.usage: Recipes say {theoretical}; the kitchen actually used {actual}, and {waste} was logged as waste. {unexplained} is unexplained ({rate}) — other branches lose {baseline}.
evidence.voidedDishes: {qty} went into dishes cooked and then voided after the kitchen ticket.
evidence.posExceptions: {count, plural, one {# POS exception} other {# POS exceptions}} found at this branch in the same period — check them together.
evidence.transferSuspected: This branch used {over} more than it should, while {toBranch} used {under} less ({match}% match) — goods probably moved without a transfer.
evidence.priceDrift: Paid above both the usual price and the market on {days} day(s): {overpay} over, {paid} spent.
evidence.transferUnconfirmed: Sent by {from} on {date}; nobody here has confirmed receiving it.
evidence.transferDisputed: Sent by {from} on {date}; less arrived than was sent.
evidence.slowSlot: {day}, {from}:00–{to}:00: {orders} orders took a median of {minutes} min to serve; the usual is {usual} min.
evidence.slowComplaints: {count, plural, one {# customer comment} other {# customer comments}} in this slot mention slow service.
evidence.lapse: {lapsed} of {regulars} regulars have not come back ({rate}; other branches {peer}).

action.review_voids: Go through these voids with the cashier and the kitchen.
action.require_manager_on_cash_voids: Make every void after the ticket need a manager's PIN (already on) and check who approved these.
action.talk_to_staff: Talk to the staff member before drawing conclusions.
action.review_discounts: Check who these discounts went to.
action.require_reason_codes: Require a reason on every discount.
action.set_discount_limit: Make large discounts need a manager's approval.
action.review_refunds: Check each refund against its original order.
action.check_digital_payments_offered: Check that bKash, Nagad and card are offered at this till.
action.spot_count_drawer: Do a surprise cash count during this person's shift.
action.recount_with_manager: Count the drawer with a manager at every close for two weeks.
action.blind_cash_count: Ask for the cash count before showing the expected amount.
action.raise_platform_prices: Price items higher on the platform to cover commission.
action.push_own_delivery: Move regulars to your own delivery.
action.review_combo_margins: Check which combos still make money after commission.
action.raise_price: Raise the price, or check the price & portion simulator first.
action.trim_portion: Check the portion against the recipe in the kitchen.
action.renegotiate_supplier: Ask suppliers for a better price on the main ingredient.
action.remove_from_platform: Take the item off this platform, or sell it there as a smaller version.
action.check_portions: Watch portions of the dishes named, and weigh a few
action.log_all_waste: Make sure every bit of waste is logged
action.lock_the_store: Keep the store locked; one person holds the key
action.recount: Recount this ingredient to rule out a counting error
action.count_both_branches: Count this ingredient at both branches today
action.check_store_keys: Check who has access to the store at both branches
action.compare_suppliers: Compare with other suppliers and branches
action.ask_for_receipts: Ask for a written receipt for every purchase
action.set_price_limits: Agree price limits with the purchaser
action.confirm_receipt: Confirm what arrived on the Stock page
action.check_transport: Check how goods are carried between branches
action.add_kitchen_staff_at_peak: Put one more cook or runner on this slot.
action.prep_before_rush: Prep the top dishes before the rush starts.
action.check_station_bottleneck: Watch the kitchen screen in this slot to see which station holds tickets up.
action.win_back_campaign: Send a win-back message to these regulars (with their consent).
action.review_price_change: Look again at the recent price rise at this branch.
action.call_regulars: Ask the manager to call a few of these regulars and ask why.

costs.label: Note

recipes.coverage: {with} of {total} menu items have a recipe.
recipes.editRecipe: Change this recipe (saves a new version)

recipes.approved: Approved. The recipe is now active.
recipes.priceHint: Per kg, litre or piece. Leave empty if you don't know yet.

recipes.menuPhoto: Or a photo of the menu

menuProfit.title: Menu profit
menuProfit.subtitle: Which dishes make money, which lose it, and what a price or portion change would do.
menuProfit.coverageHint: Food cost % is only for items with a recipe.

star.name: Stars
star.advice: Popular and profitable. Keep quality and visibility high.

plowhorse.name: Plowhorses

puzzle.name: Puzzles
puzzle.advice: Profitable but rarely ordered. Promote them.

dog.name: Dogs
dog.advice: Rarely ordered and thin. Rework or remove.

menuProfit.simBody: Try a new menu price or portion size and see the margin, at the last 28 days' sales.

menuProfit.simImpact: At the last 28 days' {qty} sold, that is {change} of margin.

assistant.help: I can answer questions like "How many mutton kacchi did we sell today?", "Sales this week?" or "Top items this month?". Ask me in Bangla, Banglish or English.
assistant.notPermitted: You don't have access to that figure. Cost and profit numbers are for the owner and accountant.
assistant.notFound: I couldn't find that item or branch. Check the name and ask again.
assistant.noData: I don't have that data yet.
assistant.cannotVerify: I couldn't give you an answer I can back with your data. Try asking about a specific item or period.
assistant.capNote: Today's AI allowance is used up, so this is the short answer.
assistant.stockFine: Nothing is running low right now.

explain.usage: {branch}, {from} to {to}: recipes called for {theoretical} of {ingredient}, the kitchen used {actual}, and {waste} was logged as waste. {unexplained} ({rate}) is unexplained, where other branches lose {baseline}. Beyond that, it is worth {impact}.
explain.posExceptions: There {count, plural, one {is # POS exception} other {are # POS exceptions}} at this branch in the same period; look at them together.
explain.usageActions: Check portions of those dishes, make sure all waste is logged, and keep the store locked.
explain.transfer: {ingredient}, {from} to {to}: {branch} used {over} more than its recipes explain, while {toBranch} used {under} less. About {qty} seems to have moved from {branch} to {toBranch} without a transfer, worth {impact}. Record transfers whenever goods move.
explain.price: {branch} paid more than the market for {ingredient} on {days} day(s) between {from} and {to} — {overpay} over, {impact} in total. Compare suppliers and ask for written receipts.
explain.unconfirmed: {fromBranch} sent goods to {branch} on {date} and nobody has confirmed receiving them (worth {impact}). Confirm it on the Stock page.
explain.generic: {type} at {branch}, {from} to {to}: {impact}. Open Leaks to see the evidence.
explain.slowSlot: {branch}: on {day}s between {fromHour}:00 and {toHour}:00, {orders} orders took a median of {minutes} minutes, against {usual} minutes at other times ({from} to {to}). About {impact} of sales happened in that slot. Add a cook at the peak, prep before the rush, or find which station is the bottleneck.
explain.lapse: {branch}: {lapsed} of {regulars} regular customers did not come back between {from} and {to} ({rate}, against {peer} at the other branches). They usually spend about {impact} in a period like this. Check any recent price change, then consider a win-back campaign.

loss.titleItems: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} used more than the recipes
loss.body: Every gram used over the recipes, added up. Using less never cancels a loss.
loss.bodyItems: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} used more than the recipes. Using less never cancels a loss.
loss.noLossBody: Nothing used more than its recipe between these two counts.
loss.definition: Over-usage = what really left your shelf − what the recipes of the dishes you sold needed.
loss.lineLabel: Count it as a loss at this much over the recipe (%)
loss.lineHint: Between 0.1% and 20%. Money leaks uses the same line.
loss.groupLoss: Loss — {pct} or more over the recipe
loss.groupSmall: Small loss — less than {pct} over the recipe
loss.groupUnder: Under-usage — used less than the recipes
loss.underBody: Not a profit. Usually a count mistake, bazar that was not entered, or smaller portions.
loss.groupOnRecipe: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} on recipe

verdict.overNoRecipe: {qty} used, but no dish sold needs it

loss.underExplain: {qty} less than the recipes. This is not counted as profit.
loss.rule: Counted as a loss to act on at {pct} or more over the recipe. Every gram over is counted in ৳.

over.portions: Are portions bigger than the recipe says?
over.waste: Was food wasted or given away without writing it down?
over.moved: Did food go to another branch or to staff meals?

under.portions: Are portions smaller than the recipe says?
under.bazar: Did bazar come in that was not entered?

ledger.waste: of which written down as waste

loss.staffFood: Staff food: {qty}. Shown on its own, not part of the loss.
loss.staffFoodMoney: Staff food: {qty} ({amount}). Shown on its own, not part of the loss.
loss.staffTitleItems: {count, plural, one {Staff food was written down for # item} other {Staff food was written down for # items}}
loss.staffBody: Food the staff ate, written down as waste with the reason “Staff food”. It costs money, but it is planned, so it is not added to the loss.

chart.recipesTitle: What the dishes you sold needed
chart.neededHint: what the recipes of the dishes you sold take
chart.extraHint: everything over that: this is your loss
chart.ariaOver: {used} left the shelf: {needed} needed for the dishes sold and {extra} extra.
chart.ariaUnder: {used} left the shelf, {less} less than the {needed} the dishes needed.
chart.ariaOn: {used} left the shelf, exactly what the dishes needed.

purchases.title: Purchases
purchases.subtitle: The bazar, entered by form, by a photo of the chit, or by voice.
purchases.linesHint: One row per item; the total paid for that row. The unit cost updates from what you paid.
purchases.aiBody: Snap the bazar chit or receipt, or say what was bought. You check the draft before anything is saved.
purchases.aiNotConfigured: AI is not set up yet (the owner needs to add an API key). You can still enter purchases by form.
purchases.photo: Photo of the chit or receipt
purchases.voiceUnsupported: Voice needs Chrome on Android or a desktop browser that supports it — typing works everywhere.
purchases.listening: Listening… speak item, quantity and price.
purchases.toCheck: {count, plural, one {# line to check} other {# lines to check}}
purchases.flaggedHint: Highlighted fields were unclear or did not match an ingredient — check them before confirming.
purchases.marketBody: Paste reference prices (for example the TCB market list) so Price Watch can compare a branch that buys alone. One line each: ingredient, taka, per (kg / litre / piece / dozen), date, source.
purchases.marketImported: Prices imported. Rows that did not match an ingredient were skipped.
purchases.forDaysHint: Xedine shows a countdown on the Stock page.

plan.title: Plan
plan.subtitle: What tomorrow will sell, what to cook, and what to buy.
plan.noBranch: You have no branch to plan for yet.
plan.flagBody: Rain, a hartal or a big match changes sales. Flag it so the forecast learns:
plan.accuracy: Last {days} days: forecast off by {model} on average, “same day last week” by {naive}. The better one is shown.
plan.noForecastBody: The forecast needs a few weeks of sales.
plan.forecastHint: Units, not taka. Closed days forecast zero; flagged days and salary week are taken into account.
plan.bazarBody: Forecast need + safety stock − what should be in stock after today − goods on the way, rounded up to the pack you buy in. The manager approves; changes teach the next suggestion.
plan.noList: No list for this day yet
plan.noListBody: Make a draft from the forecast and your stock.
plan.nothingToBuy: Nothing to buy: stock covers the forecast.
plan.approveHint: Leave a box empty to buy as suggested; 0 drops the line.
plan.managerApproves: The owner or manager approves the list.
plan.sent: Queued: suppliers get their lines, the purchaser the whole list.
plan.sendHint: Suppliers with a phone number get their own lines. Messages go out once WhatsApp is set up.
plan.reconcileHint: Compares the list with the purchases entered for the day.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.subtitle: Ramadan, Eid, holidays and the days that change sales. The forecast reads this.
calendar.name: Name
calendar.closedLabel: We are closed on these days
calendar.verifyHint: Religious and national dates are estimates until confirmed each year — check them.

customers.title: Customers
customers.subtitle: Who comes back, who is slipping away, and how fast they are served.
customers.summaryHint: Based on {firstTimers} first-time customers. Only orders with a phone number count.
customers.noneBody: Customers appear when the cashier adds a phone number to an order.
customers.daysAgo: {days, plural, one {# day ago} other {# days ago}}
customers.segmentsHint: Lost: no visit for 90 days. At risk: a repeat customer who has been away more than twice their usual gap (at least 30 days). Regular: 4 or more visits in 90 days. New: one visit so far. RFM scores recency, frequency and spend from 1 to 5.
customers.serviceTitle: Median minutes from order to served
customers.serviceBody: The usual time at this branch is {minutes} minutes. Slots in red are much slower with enough orders to be sure.
customers.serviceHint: Last 28 days. Times come from the kitchen screen (order placed to ticket done).

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.subtitle: Messages to customers who said yes — approved by you, capped, and measured against a holdout group.
campaigns.name: Name
campaigns.kindHint: The holdout group gets nothing, so the result shows what the message really changed. Customers without consent, or messaged in the last 7 days, are skipped.
campaigns.bodyHint: Customers get the message in their language. Reply STOP always opts out.
campaigns.noneBody: Start with a win-back message for regulars who stopped coming.
campaigns.autoHint: Runs every morning for new customers who match — still only those who consented.
campaigns.resultLine: Messaged {treated} customers, {treatedRate} came back. Holdout {holdout}, {holdoutRate} came back.
campaigns.notEnough: Not enough customers yet to say whether it worked (need 30 in each group).
campaigns.created: Draft saved. Approve it to send.
campaigns.ran: Queued. Customers without consent or over the limit were skipped.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.subtitle: Every review and after-meal comment in one place, with what was happening that day.
reviews.author: Name (optional)
reviews.googleNote: Google reviews will come in by themselves once the Business Profile connection is approved; until then, paste them here.
reviews.aiNotConfigured: AI drafts are off until an AI key is added. You can still write replies yourself.
reviews.context: That day ({date}): median serve time {ticket} min (usual {usual} min). On duty: {staff}. Dishes mentioned: {items}.
reviews.replyApproved: Reply approved — post it on the platform
reviews.replyApprovedOk: Approved. Copy it to the platform to post.

feedbackPage.title: How was your meal?
feedbackPage.question: How likely are you to recommend us to a friend? 0 is not at all, 10 is definitely.
feedbackPage.privacy: Your answer goes only to the restaurant. Reply STOP on WhatsApp to stop messages.
feedbackPage.expiredBody: It was already used, or it is more than 14 days old.

branches.title: Branches
branches.subtitle: Which branch is doing best, what the others would keep at its level, and what moves between them.
branches.leagueHint: Up to yesterday. Cost figures are for the owner and accountant.
branches.leagueHintMoney: Up to yesterday. Gap to best: what this branch would have kept at the best branch’s rate for waste, labour, discounts, voids and unexplained usage.
branches.noGapsBody: Branches are level, or there is not enough data yet (unexplained usage needs two stock counts).
branches.gapsHint: Each amount is exact: this branch’s spend minus what it would have been at the best branch’s rate on its own sales. Food cost % is left out — it follows the menu mix; see Same items.
branches.noItems: No items are sold in more than one branch in this period
branches.itemsTitle: The same items, branch by branch
branches.itemsHint: Units sold per trading day, and below it the average price actually received after discounts.
branches.scorecardHint: Only this branch’s figures are shown, with its place among all branches. No cost or profit figures.
branches.noTransfers: No transfers in the last 90 days
branches.transfersHint: Short: a line received more than 2% below what was sent. Goods that moved with no transfer at all show up on the Leaks page.

benchmarks.title: Benchmarks
benchmarks.subtitle: Your last full month next to similar restaurants.
benchmarks.optedIn: You share anonymous figures and see your peers’
benchmarks.notOptedIn: You are not sharing figures yet
benchmarks.optInBody: Sharing is anonymous: only ranges from groups of five or more restaurants are ever shown, never a single restaurant. Until you opt in, you see labelled reference ranges only.
benchmarks.noneBody: Ranges appear once five similar restaurants share their figures, or when reference ranges are loaded.
benchmarks.notEnoughOwn: Not enough of your own data for this one
benchmarks.noRange: No range for this figure yet.

place.p25_p50: Between the lower quarter and the middle.
place.p50_p75: Between the middle and the upper quarter.

benchmarks.referenceNote: Reference range, not live peer data.
benchmarks.privacy: Food cost % is compared only for restaurants with recipes on at least 90% of sales. Figures are pooled once a month.

compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.subtitle: Licences, the VAT return and what to hand the accountant — with reminders before anything lapses.
compliance.remindersHint: The owner gets a WhatsApp reminder 60, 30 and 7 days before a licence expires, and 7 and 2 days before the VAT return — once each.
compliance.vatDisclaimer: A working summary from your orders for the accountant — not a filed return. Check the return’s format with your accountant.
compliance.dueDayHint: Set this to the day your accountant files by. Xedine does not assume a legal date.
compliance.reminderVat: VAT return for {month} is due on {date} ({days} day(s) left).

staffRecords.title: Staff records
staffRecords.subtitle: Attendance, advances and who sells what.
staffRecords.noStaff: No active staff at this branch
staffRecords.name: Name
staffRecords.summaryHint: Days not marked are counted separately, not as absent.
staffRecords.advancesHint: Owner only. Every entry is kept in the audit log.
staffRecords.noSales: No orders taken by staff in the last 30 days
staffRecords.salesHint: Orders are credited to the staff member who took them at the till.

setup.title: Setup
setup.subtitle: {done} of {total} steps done. Each step ticks itself when the data is in.

profile.title: Restaurant profile
profile.body: Cuisine and city, for reports and benchmarks.

menu.title: Menu
menu.body: At least five items with prices — import them on the right.

channels.title: Sales channels
channels.body: Dine-in, takeaway, foodpanda… with their commission.

staff_pins.title: Staff PINs
staff_pins.body: Cashiers sign in to the till with a PIN.

pos_device.title: Pair the till
pos_device.body: Approve the tablet or phone that runs the POS.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.body: Recipes for 90% of the menu, so food cost is real.

ingredient_prices.title: Ingredient prices
ingredient_prices.body: A price for every ingredient in a recipe.

fixed_costs.title: Fixed costs
fixed_costs.body: Rent, utilities and other monthly costs.

opening_count.title: Opening stock count
opening_count.body: The starting point for stock and variance.

owner_whatsapp.title: Owner WhatsApp
owner_whatsapp.body: For the morning brief and reminders.

first_order.title: First order
first_order.body: Ring up a real order on the POS.

setup.csvHint: Columns: category, name, Bangla name (optional), price. Items that already exist are skipped, never changed.
setup.draftHint: Read from your photo by AI — check every name and price, fix anything wrong, then import.
setup.imported: {created} item(s) added, {skipped} already on the menu.
setup.photo: Menu photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB)
setup.photoRead: Done — check the draft above before importing.
setup.photoHint: The AI copies what is printed; a price it cannot read is left empty for you to fill in.
setup.aiOff: Photo reading is off until an AI key is added. Paste the menu instead.

billing.title: Billing
billing.subtitle: Your plan, what it includes, and what next month costs.
billing.trialEnded: The free trial ended on {date}. AI and WhatsApp are paused until a plan is active.

planBody.starter: POS, kitchen screen, orders, cash, the health monitor and the zero-input leak checks.
planBody.growth: Everything: recipes and menu profit, AI assistant and WhatsApp, purchasing, stock and waste, forecasts, customers and reviews.
planBody.chain: Growth for 6 or more branches, with branch comparisons and benchmarks.

billing.paymentNote: Prices are provisional. Payment is by invoice (bank or bKash) until online payment is set up.

admin.title: Admin
admin.subtitle: Restaurants, their plans and status. No sales, cost or customer data is shown here.
admin.meta: {slug} · {branches} branch(es) · traded on {days} of the last 30 days

growth.title: Growth
growth.subtitle: Content ideas grounded in your own sales data — you write or approve everything before it goes anywhere.
growth.aiNotConfigured: AI drafts are off until an AI key is added. You can still write ideas yourself.
growth.pushItemFact: {item} sold {qty} times in the last 28 days.
growth.fixDaypartFact: {weak} is only {weakShare} of sales, against {strongShare} at {strong}, over the last 28 days.
growth.noneBody: Draft one from a strong seller or a quiet time above, or write your own.
growth.drafted: Idea drafted below — check it before approving.
growth.noAutoPost: Xedine never posts anything by itself. Copy an approved caption to the platform yourself, then mark it posted.

features.title: Features
features.subtitle: Keep Xedine simple: switch on only what your restaurant uses. Switched-on features appear in the sidebar.
features.footnote: Switching a feature off only hides it. Nothing is deleted, and staff whose job it is (like a purchaser) still see it.

recipes.title: Recipes & food cost
recipes.body: Recipes for each dish, so Xedine knows your real food cost and profit per item.

purchasing.title: Purchases & suppliers
purchasing.body: Record bazar and supplier bills, from a photo or by voice.

planning.title: Forecast & shopping list
planning.body: What tomorrow will sell, what to cook and what to buy.

customers.title: Customers & marketing
customers.body: Regulars, win-back offers and content ideas.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.body: Collect feedback and draft replies to reviews.

branches.title: Branch comparison
branches.body: Compare branches side by side and against similar restaurants.

compliance.title: Licences & VAT
compliance.body: Licence renewal reminders and the monthly VAT summary.

telegramPage.title: Telegram bazar bot
telegramPage.subtitle: Purchasers send the day’s bazar to a Telegram bot, typed or by voice, and tap ✅ to add it to stock. No need to open Xedine.
telegramPage.notSetUp: The Telegram bot is not set up yet. Create a bot with @BotFather, then add TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME and TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET to the server settings.
telegramPage.connectBody: Make a one-time link and send it to the person (WhatsApp, SMS, any way). When they tap it, Telegram opens the bot and their chat is connected.
telegramPage.linkHint: The link works once and expires after 48 hours. Only the owner and purchasers can record the bazar.
telegramPage.noPurchasers: No one can record purchases yet. Invite a purchaser on the Team page first.
telegramPage.how1: The purchaser sends the list, one item per line: name, quantity, unit, total paid (e.g. murgi 10 kg 1800).
telegramPage.how2: The bot answers with every line it understood, matched to your ingredients, and the total.
telegramPage.how3: Nothing changes until they tap ✅ Add to stock. Then the purchase is recorded in their name and stock goes up.
telegramPage.how4Voice: Voice notes and photos of the chit work too.
telegramPage.how4NoVoice: Voice notes and photos need AI: add an OpenAI key to switch them on. Typed lists work without it.

chatBot.heading: 🧾 {branch} · bazar of {date}

flags.no_match: could not read the unit or price
flags.unit_mismatch: that unit does not fit this item
flags.no_total: no price: write the total paid
flags.pick: which item is this? Tap it below

chatBot.needsFix: Some lines need fixing. Send the whole list again with them corrected, or fix it in Xedine → Purchases → From photo or voice.
chatBot.notConnected: This chat is not connected to a restaurant yet. Ask the owner for a Xedine link and tap it.
chatBot.notAllowed: You can no longer record purchases for this branch. Please ask the owner.
chatBot.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
chatBot.linkInvalid: This link was already used, has expired, or is wrong. Ask the owner for a new one.
chatBot.welcome: Connected ✅ You are recording the bazar for {org}, {branch}.
chatBot.help:
Send today’s bazar like this:
murgi 10 kg 1800 3 din
piyaj 5 kg 300
dim 2 dozen 330

One item per line: name, quantity, unit, total paid, and how many days it is for. I will show you the list; tap ✅ to add it to stock.
/stop disconnects this chat.
chatBot.stopped: Disconnected. This chat will no longer record purchases.
chatBot.voiceOff: Voice notes are not switched on yet. Please type the list.
chatBot.photoOff: Reading photos is not switched on yet. Please type the list.
chatBot.tooLong: That is too long for me. Keep a voice note under 5 minutes.
chatBot.nothingFound: I could not find any items in that. Write each item like: murgi 10 kg 1800

ai.aiNotConfigured: Reading this needs AI, which is not switched on yet. Please type the list like: murgi 10 kg 1800
ai.aiCapExceeded: Today’s AI allowance is used up. Please type the list like: murgi 10 kg 1800
ai.aiNotInPlan: Your restaurant’s plan does not include AI. Please type the list like: murgi 10 kg 1800
ai.aiFailed: I could not read that this time. Please try again, or type the list.

chatBot.newItemsNote: 🆕 = new item. Tapping ✅ also adds it to your ingredient list.
chatBot.pickBelow: Tap the right item for each ❓ line (or 🆕 if it is new). Then ✅ appears.
chatBot.daysNote: 📅 = how many days it is for. The owner sees a countdown in Xedine. To change it, tap a number below.
chatBot.askDays: 📅 For how many days is this bazar? Tap a number below. If you skip it, the owner sees no countdown.

stockGuard.title: Stock Guard
stockGuard.intro: {count, plural, one {# thing} other {# things}} in your stock records to check.
stockGuard.allClear: All clear ✅ Nothing in your stock records needs checking.
stockGuard.howItWorks: Stock Guard checks your purchases, counts and waste with fixed rules every time you open this page. It never changes anything by itself.
stockGuard.hidden: Hidden. Its history stays, and buying it again brings it back.

priceTypo.title: {name}: the price looks wrong
priceTypo.body: Paid {paid} for {qty} on {date}. Usually that much costs about {usual}. Check the chit: a zero too many or too few?

belowZero.title: {name}: records say {qty} left
belowZero.body: Less than nothing is impossible: a purchase may not be recorded, or the last count was wrong. Count it again.

idleStock.title: {name}: {qty} sitting unused
idleStock.body: Not bought, used or thrown away since {date}. This is money on the shelf: use it in a dish, or log it as waste if it went bad.

newItem.title: {name}: new item
newItem.byWhom: Added by {who} from Telegram on {date}. It already counts in stock and money leaks. Check the name is right.
newItem.body: Added from Telegram on {date}. It already counts in stock and money leaks. Check the name is right.

unused.title: {name}: not bought any more?
unused.body: Last bought {date} and none is left. Hide it from the bazar list and counts? Its history stays.

unusedUnknown.title: {name}: is any left?
unusedUnknown.body: Last bought {date} and never counted. If none is left, hide it from the bazar list and counts. If some is left, count it first.
